text_pt: Desvia-te dele, para que tenha repouso, até que, como o jornaleiro, tenha contentamento no seu dia.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσαν τὸν Αχιωρ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Οζια ὡς δὲ ἦλθεν καὶ εἶδεν τὴν κεφαλὴν Ολοφέρνου ἐν χειρὶ ἀνδρὸς ἑνὸς ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ λαοῦ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον καὶ ἐξελύθη τὸ πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And immediately at break of day, they hung up the head of Holofernes upon the walls, and every man took his arms, and they went out with a great noise and shouting.
text_la: Mox autem ut ortus est dies, suspenderunt super muros caput Holofernis, accepitque unusquisque vir arma sua, et egressi sunt cum grandi strepitu et ululatu.
text_pt: Porque há esperança para a árvore que, se for cortada, ainda se renovará, e não cessarão os seus renovos.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἀνέλαβον αὐτόν προσέπεσεν τοῖς ποσὶν Ιουδιθ καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ προσώπῳ αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογημένη σὺ ἐν παντὶ σκηνώματι Ιουδα καὶ ἐν παντὶ ἔθνει οἵτινες ἀκούσαντες τὸ ὄνομά σου ταραχθήσονται

text_en: And the watchmen seeing this, ran to the tent of Holofernes.
text_la: Quod videntes exploratores, ad tabernaculum Holofernis cucurrerunt.
text_pt: Se envelhecer na terra a sua raiz, e o seu tronco morrer no pó,
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀνάγγειλόν μοι ὅσα ἐποίησας ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῷ Ιουδιθ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ πάντα ὅσα ἦν πεποιηκυῖα ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἐξῆλθεν ἕως οὗ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they that were in the tent came, and made a noise, before the door of the chamber to awake him, endeavouring by art to break his rest, that Holofernes might awake, not by their calling him, but by their noise.
text_la: Porro hi qui in tabernaculo erant, venientes, et ante ingressum cubiculi perstrepentes, excitandi gratia, inquietudinem arte moliebantur, ut non ab excitantibus, sed a sonantibus Holofernes evigilaret.
text_pt: Ao cheiro das águas brotará, e dará ramos como uma planta.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπαύσατο λαλοῦσα ἠλάλαξεν ὁ λαὸς φωνῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἔδωκεν φωνὴν εὐφρόσυνον ἐν τῇ πόλει αὐτῶν

text_en: For no man dared knock, or open and go into the chamber of the general of the Assyrians .
text_la: Nullus enim audebat cubiculum virtutis Assyriorum pulsando aut intrando aperire.
text_pt: Porém, morto o homem, é consumido; sim, rendendo o homem o espírito, então onde está ele?
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Αχιωρ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐπίστευσεν τῷ θεῷ σφόδρα καὶ περιετέμετο τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτοῦ καὶ προσετέθη εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ισραηλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: But when his captains and tribunes had come, and all the chiefs of the army of the king of the Assyrians , they said to the chamberlains:
text_la: Sed cum venissent ejus duces ac tribuni, et universi majores exercitus regis Assyriorum, dixerunt cubiculariis:
text_pt: Como as águas se retiram do mar, e o rio se esgota, e fica seco,
text_el: ἡνίκα δὲ ὁ ὄρθρος ἀνέβη καὶ ἐκρέμασαν τὴν κεφαλὴν Ολοφέρνου ἐκ τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἀνέλαβεν πᾶς ἀνὴρ τὰ ὅπλα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξήλθοσαν κατὰ σπείρας ἐπὶ τὰς ἀναβάσεις τοῦ ὄρους

text_en: Go in, and awake him, for the mice, coming out of their holes, have presumed to challenge us to fight.
text_la: Intrate, et excitate illum, quoniam egressi mures de cavernis suis, ausi sunt provocare nos ad prælium.
text_pt: Assim o homem se deita, e não se levanta; até que não haja mais céus, não acordará nem despertará de seu sono.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ασσουρ ὡς εἶδον αὐτούς διέπεμψαν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἡγουμένους αὐτῶν οἱ δὲ ἦλθον ἐπὶ τοὺς στρατηγοὺς καὶ χιλιάρχους καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα ἄρχοντα αὐτῶν

text_en: Then Vagao going into his chamber, stood before the curtain, and made a clapping with his hands: for he thought that he was sleeping with Judith.
text_la: Tunc ingressus Vagao cubiculum ejus, stetit ante cortinam, et plausum fecit manibus suis : suspicabatur enim illum cum Judith dormire.
text_pt: Quem dera que me escondesses na sepultura, e me ocultasses até que a tua ira se fosse; e me pusesses um limite, e te lembrasses de mim!
text_el: καὶ παρεγένοντο ἐπὶ τὴν σκηνὴν Ολοφέρνου καὶ εἶπαν τῷ ὄντι ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν αὐτοῦ ἔγειρον δὴ τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐτόλμησαν οἱ δοῦλοι καταβαίνειν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς εἰς πόλεμον ἵνα ἐξολεθρευθῶσιν εἰς τέλος

text_en: But when with hearkening, he perceived no motion of one lying, he came near to the curtain, and lifting it up, and seeing the body of Holofernes, lying upon the ground, without the head, weltering in his blood, he cried out with a loud voice, with weeping, and rent his garments.
text_la: Sed cum nullum motum jacentis sensu aurium caperet, accessit proximans ad cortinam, et elevans eam, vidensque cadaver absque capite Holofernis in suo sanguine tabefactum jacere super terram, exclamavit voce magna cum fletu, et scidit vestimenta sua.
text_pt: Morrendo o homem, porventura tornará a viver? Todos os dias de meu combate esperaria, até que viesse a minha mudança.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Βαγώας καὶ ἔκρουσε τὴν αὐλαίαν τῆς σκηνῆς ὑπενόει γὰρ καθεύδειν αὐτὸν μετὰ Ιουδιθ

text_en: And he went into the tent of Judith, and not finding her, he ran out to the people,
text_la: Et ingressus tabernaculum Judith, non invenit eam, et exiliit foras ad populum,
text_pt: Chamar-me-ias, e eu te responderia, e terias afeto à obra de tuas mãos.
text_el: ὡς δ' οὐθεὶς ἐπήκουσεν διαστείλας εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν κοιτῶνα καὶ εὗρεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς χελωνίδος ἐρριμμένον νεκρόν καὶ ἡ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ ἀφῄρητο ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: and said: One Hebrew woman has made confusion in the house of King Nabuchodonosor : for behold Holofernes lies upon the ground, and his head is not upon him.
text_la: et dixit : Una mulier hebræa fecit confusionem in domo regis Nabuchodonosor : ecce enim Holofernes jacet in terra, et caput ejus non est in illo.
text_pt: Mas agora contas os meus passos; porventura não vigias sobre o meu pecado?
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ καὶ στεναγμοῦ καὶ βοῆς ἰσχυρᾶς καὶ διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now when the chiefs of the army of the Assyrians had heard this, they all rent their garments, and an intolerable fear and dread fell upon them, and their minds were troubled exceedingly.
text_la: Quod cum audissent principes virtutis Assyriorum, sciderunt omnes vestimenta sua, et intolerabilis timor et tremor cecidit super eos, et turbati sunt animi eorum valde.
text_pt: A minha transgressão está selada num saco, e amontoas as minhas iniqüidades.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὴν σκηνήν οὗ ἦν Ιουδιθ καταλύουσα καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν αὐτήν καὶ ἐξεπήδησεν εἰς τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἐβόησεν

text_en: And there was a very great cry in the midst of their camp.
text_la: Et factus est clamor incomparabilis in medio castrorum eorum.
text_pt: E, na verdade, caindo a montanha, desfaz-se; e a rocha se remove do seu lugar.
text_el: ἠθέτησαν οἱ δοῦλοι ἐποίησεν αἰσχύνην μία γυνὴ τῶν Εβραίων εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ βασιλέως Ναβουχοδονοσορ ὅτι ἰδοὺ Ολοφέρνης χαμαί καὶ ἡ κεφαλὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_pt: As águas gastam as pedras, as cheias afogam o pó da terra; e tu fazes perecer a esperança do homem;
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς δυνάμεως Ασσουρ τοὺς χιτῶνας αὐτῶν διέρρηξαν καὶ ἐταράχθη αὐτῶν ἡ ψυχὴ σφόδρα καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῶν κραυγὴ καὶ βοὴ μεγάλη σφόδρα ἐν μέσῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And when all the army heard that Holofernes was beheaded, courage and counsel fled from them, and being seized with trembling and fear they thought only to save themselves by flight.
text_la: Cumque omnis exercitus decollatum Holofernem audisset, fugit mens et consilium ab eis, et solo tremore et metu agitati, fugæ præsidium sumunt,
text_pt: Então respondeu Elifaz o temanita, e disse:
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἤκουσαν οἱ ἐν τοῖς σκηνώμασιν ὄντες ἐξέστησαν ἐπὶ τὸ γεγονός

text_en: So that no one spoke to his neighbour, but hanging down the head, leaving all things behind, they made haste to escape from the Hebrews , who, as they heard, were coming armed upon them, and fled by the ways of the fields, and the paths of the hills.
text_la: ita ut nullus loqueretur cum proximo suo, sed inclinato capite, relictis omnibus, evadere festinabant Hebræos, quos armatos super se venire audiebant, fugientes per vias camporum et semitas collium.
text_pt: Porventura proferirá o sábio và sabedoria? E encherá do vento oriental o seu ventre,
text_el: καὶ ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τρόμος καὶ φόβος καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἄνθρωπος μένων κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ πλησίον ἔτι ἀλλ' ἐκχυθέντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἔφευγον ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ὁδὸν τοῦ πεδίου καὶ τῆς ὀρεινῆς

text_en: So the children of Israel seeing them fleeing, followed after them. And they went down sounding with trumpets and shouting after them.
text_la: Videntes itaque filii Israël fugientes, secuti sunt illos. Descenderuntque clangentes tubis, et ululantes post ipsos.
text_pt: Argüindo com palavras que de nada servem, e com razões, de que nada aproveita?
text_el: καὶ οἱ παρεμβεβληκότες ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ κύκλῳ Βαιτυλουα καὶ ἐτράπησαν εἰς φυγήν καὶ τότε οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πᾶς ἀνὴρ πολεμιστὴς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐξεχύθησαν ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And because the Assyrians were not united together, they went without order in their flight; but the children of Israel pursuing in one body, defeated all that they could find.
text_la: Et quoniam Assyrii non adunati, in fugam ibant præcipites : filii autem Israël uno agmine persequentes debilitabant omnes quos invenire potuissent.
text_pt: E tu tens feito vão o temor, e diminuis os rogos diante de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Οζιας εἰς Βαιτομασθαιμ καὶ Βηβαι καὶ Χωβαι καὶ Κωλα καὶ εἰς πᾶν ὅριον Ισραηλ τοὺς ἀπαγγέλλοντας ὑπὲρ τῶν συντετελεσμένων καὶ ἵνα πάντες ἐπεκχυθῶσιν τοῖς πολεμίοις εἰς τὴν ἀναίρεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And Ozias sent messengers through all the cities and countries of Israel .
text_la: Misit itaque Ozias nuntios per omnes civitates et regiones Israël.
text_pt: Porque a tua boca declara a tua iniqüidade; e tu escolhes a língua dos astutos.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ πάντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐπέπεσον ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔκοπτον αὐτοὺς ἕως Χωβα ὡσαύτως δὲ καὶ οἱ ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ παρεγενήθησαν καὶ ἐκ πάσης τῆς ὀρεινῆς ἀνήγγειλαν γὰρ αὐτοῖς τὰ γεγονότα τῇ παρεμβολῇ τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐν Γαλααδ καὶ οἱ ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ ὑπερεκέρασαν αὐτοὺς πληγῇ μεγάλῃ ἕως οὗ παρῆλθον Δαμασκὸν καὶ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῆς

text_en: And every country, and every city, sent their chosen young men armed after them, and they pursued them with the edge of the sword until they came to the extremities of their confines.
text_la: Omnis itaque regio, omnisque urbs electam juventutem armatam misit post eos, et persecuti sunt eos in ore gladii, quousque pervenirent ad extremitatem finium suorum.
text_pt: A tua boca te condena, e não eu, e os teus lábios testificam contra ti.
text_el: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Βαιτυλουα ἐπέπεσαν τῇ παρεμβολῇ Ασσουρ καὶ ἐπρονόμευσαν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπλούτησαν σφόδρα

text_en: And the rest that were in Bethulia went into the camp of the Assyrians , and took away the spoils which the Assyrians in their flight had left behind them, and they were laden exceedingly,
text_la: Reliqui autem qui erant in Bethulia, ingressi sunt castra Assyriorum, et prædam quam fugientes Assyrii reliquerant, abstulerunt, et onustati sunt valde.
text_pt: És tu porventura o primeiro homem que nasceu? Ou foste formado antes dos outeiros?
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀναστρέψαντες ἀπὸ τῆς κοπῆς ἐκυρίευσαν τῶν λοιπῶν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι καὶ ἐπαύλεις ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ καὶ πεδινῇ ἐκράτησαν πολλῶν λαφύρων ἦν γὰρ πλῆθος πολὺ σφόδρα

text_en: but they that returned conquerors to Bethulia , brought with them all things that were theirs, so that there was no numbering of their cattle, and beasts, and all their moveables, insomuch that from the least to the greatest all were made rich by their spoils.
text_la: Hi vero qui victores reversi sunt ad Bethuliam, omnia quæ erant illorum attulerunt secum, ita ut non esset numerus in pecoribus et jumentis et universis mobilibus eorum, ut a minimo usque ad maximum omnes divites fierent de prædationibus eorum.
text_pt: Ou ouviste o secreto conselho de Deus e a ti só limitaste a sabedoria?
text_el: καὶ Ιωακιμ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας καὶ ἡ γερουσία τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἦλθον τοῦ θεάσασθαι τὰ ἀγαθά ἃ ἐποίησεν κύριος τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ τοῦ ἰδεῖν τὴν Ιουδιθ καὶ λαλῆσαι μετ' αὐτῆς εἰρήνην

text_en: And Joachim the high priest came from Jerusalem to Bethulia with all his ancients to see Judith.
text_la: Joacim autem summus pontifex de Jerusalem venit in Bethuliam cum universis presbyteris suis ut videret Judith.
text_pt: Que sabes tu, que nós não saibamos? Que entendes, que não haja em nós?
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἰσῆλθον πρὸς αὐτήν εὐλόγησαν αὐτὴν πάντες ὁμοθυμαδὸν καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτήν σὺ ὕψωμα Ιερουσαλημ σὺ γαυρίαμα μέγα τοῦ Ισραηλ σὺ καύχημα μέγα τοῦ γένους ἡμῶν

text_en: And when she had come out to him, they all blessed her with one voice, saying: You are the glory of Jerusalem , you are the joy of Israel , you are the honour of our people:
text_la: Quæ cum exisset ad illum, benedixerunt eam omnes una voce, dicentes : Tu gloria Jerusalem; tu lætitia Israël; tu honorificentia populi nostri:
text_pt: Também há entre nós encanecidos e idosos, muito mais idosos do que teu pai.
text_el: ἐποίησας ταῦτα πάντα ἐν χειρί σου ἐποίησας τὰ ἀγαθὰ μετὰ Ισραηλ καὶ εὐδόκησεν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ὁ θεός εὐλογημένη γίνου παρὰ τῷ παντοκράτορι κυρίῳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα χρόνον καὶ εἶπεν πᾶς ὁ λαός γένοιτο

text_en: For you have done manfully, and your heart has been strengthened, because you have loved chastity, and after your husband have not known any other: therefore also the hand of the Lord has strengthened you, and therefore you shall be blessed for ever.
text_la: quia fecisti viriliter, et confortatum est cor tuum, eo quod castitatem amaveris, et post virum tuum, alterum nescieris : ideo et manus Domini confortavit te, et ideo eris benedicta in æternum.
text_pt: Porventura fazes pouco caso das consolações de Deus, e da suave palavra que te dirigimos?
text_el: καὶ ἐλαφύρευσεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὴν παρεμβολὴν ἐφ' ἡμέρας τριάκοντα καὶ ἔδωκαν τῇ Ιουδιθ τὴν σκηνὴν Ολοφέρνου καὶ πάντα τὰ ἀργυρώματα καὶ τὰς κλίνας καὶ τὰ ὁλκεῖα καὶ πάντα τὰ κατασκευάσματα αὐτοῦ καὶ λαβοῦσα αὐτὴ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὴν ἡμίονον αὐτῆς καὶ ἔζευξεν τὰς ἁμάξας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐσώρευσεν αὐτὰ ἐπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And all the people said: So be it, so be it.
text_la: Et dixit omnis populus : Fiat, fiat.
text_pt: Por que te arrebata o teu coração, e por que piscam os teus olhos?
text_el: καὶ συνέδραμεν πᾶσα γυνὴ Ισραηλ τοῦ ἰδεῖν αὐτὴν καὶ εὐλόγησαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῇ χορὸν ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβεν θύρσους ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῆς καὶ ἔδωκεν ταῖς γυναιξὶν ταῖς μετ' αὐτῆς

text_en: And thirty days were scarce sufficient for the people of Israel to gather up the spoils of the Assyrians .
text_la: Per dies autem triginta, vix collecta sunt spolia Assyriorum a populo Israël.
text_pt: Para virares contra Deus o teu espírito, e deixares sair tais palavras da tua boca?
text_el: καὶ ἐστεφανώσαντο τὴν ἐλαίαν αὐτὴ καὶ αἱ μετ' αὐτῆς καὶ προῆλθεν παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν χορείᾳ ἡγουμένη πασῶν τῶν γυναικῶν καὶ ἠκολούθει πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ ἐνωπλισμένοι μετὰ στεφάνων καὶ ὕμνουν ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: But all those things that were proved to be the peculiar goods of Holofernes, they gave to Judith in gold, and silver, and garments and precious stones , and all household stuff, and they all were delivered to her by the people.
text_la: Porro autem universa quæ Holofernis peculiaria fuisse probata sunt, dederunt Judith in auro, et argento, et vestibus, et gemmis, et omni supellectili : et tradita sunt omnia illi a populo.
text_pt: Que é o homem, para que seja puro? E o que nasce da mulher, para ser justo?
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆρχεν Ιουδιθ τὴν ἐξομολόγησιν ταύτην ἐν παντὶ Ισραηλ καὶ ὑπερεφώνει πᾶς ὁ λαὸς τὴν αἴνεσιν ταύτην

text_en: And all the people rejoiced, with the women , and virgins, and young men, playing on instruments and harps.
text_la: Et omnes populi gaudebant cum mulieribus, et virginibus, et juvenibus, in organis et citharis.
text_pt: Eis que ele não confia nos seus santos, e nem os céus são puros aos seus olhos.

text_en: Then Judith sung this canticle to the Lord , saying:
text_la: Tunc cantavit canticum hoc Domino Judith, dicens:
text_pt: Então respondeu Jó, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιουδιθ ἐξάρχετε τῷ θεῷ μου ἐν τυμπάνοις ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν κυμβάλοις ἐναρμόσασθε αὐτῷ ψαλμὸν καὶ αἶνον ὑψοῦτε καὶ ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Begin to the Lord with timbrels, sing to the Lord with cymbals, tune unto him a new psalm, extol and call upon his name .
text_la: Incipite Domino in tympanis; cantate Domino in cymbalis; modulamini illi psalmum novum : exaltate, et invocate nomen ejus.
text_pt: Tenho ouvido muitas coisas como estas; todos vós sois consoladores molestos.
text_el: ὅτι θεὸς συντρίβων πολέμους κύριος ὅτι εἰς παρεμβολὰς αὐτοῦ ἐν μέσῳ λαοῦ ἐξείλατό με ἐκ χειρὸς καταδιωκόντων με

text_en: The Lord puts an end to wars, the Lord is his name .
text_la: Dominus conterens bella, Dominus nomen est illi.
text_pt: Porventura não terão fim essas palavras de vento? Ou o que te irrita, para assim responderes?
text_el: ἦλθεν Ασσουρ ἐξ ὀρέων ἀπὸ βορρᾶ ἦλθεν ἐν μυριάσι δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ὧν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτῶν ἐνέφραξεν χειμάρρους καὶ ἡ ἵππος αὐτῶν ἐκάλυψεν βουνούς

text_en: He has set his camp in the midst of his people, to deliver us from the hand of all our enemies.
text_la: Qui posuit castra sua in medio populi sui, ut eriperet nos de manu omnium inimicorum nostrorum.
text_pt: Falaria eu também como vós falais, se a vossa alma estivesse em lugar da minha alma, ou amontoaria palavras contra vós, e menearia contra vós a minha cabeça?
text_el: εἶπεν ἐμπρήσειν τὰ ὅριά μου καὶ τοὺς νεανίσκους μου ἀνελεῖν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ τὰ θηλάζοντά μου θήσειν εἰς ἔδαφος καὶ τὰ νήπιά μου δώσειν εἰς προνομὴν καὶ τὰς παρθένους μου σκυλεῦσαι

text_en: The Assyrian came out of the mountains from the north in the multitude of his strength: his multitude stopped up the torrents, and their horses covered the valleys.
text_la: Venit Assur ex montibus ab aquilone in multitudine fortitudinis suæ : cujus multitudo obturavit torrentes, et equi eorum cooperuerunt valles.
text_pt: Antes vos fortaleceria com a minha boca, e a consolação dos meus lábios abrandaria a vossa dor.
text_el: κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἠθέτησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ θηλείας

text_en: He bragged that he would set my borders on fire, and kill my young men with the sword, to make my infants a prey, and my virgins captives.
text_la: Dixit se incensurum fines meos, et juvenes meos occisurum gladio; infantes meos dare in prædam, et virgines in captivitatem.
text_pt: Se eu falar, a minha dor não cessa, e, calando-me eu, qual é o meu alívio?
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ὑπέπεσεν ὁ δυνατὸς αὐτῶν ὑπὸ νεανίσκων οὐδὲ υἱοὶ τιτάνων ἐπάταξαν αὐτόν οὐδὲ ὑψηλοὶ γίγαντες ἐπέθεντο αὐτῷ ἀλλὰ Ιουδιθ θυγάτηρ Μεραρι ἐν κάλλει προσώπου αὐτῆς παρέλυσεν αὐτόν

text_en: But the almighty Lord has struck him, and has delivered him into the hands of a woman , and has slain him.
text_la: Dominus autem omnipotens nocuit eum, et tradidit eum in manus feminæ, et confodit eum.
text_pt: Na verdade, agora tu me tens fatigado; tu assolaste toda a minha companhia,
text_el: ἐξεδύσατο γὰρ στολὴν χηρεύσεως αὐτῆς εἰς ὕψος τῶν πονούντων ἐν Ισραηλ ἠλείψατο τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς ἐν μυρισμῷ

text_en: For their mighty one did not fall by young men, neither did the sons of Titan strike him, nor tall giants oppose themselves to him, but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her face.
text_la: Non enim cecidit potens eorum a juvenibus, nec filii Titan percusserunt eum, nec excelsi gigantes opposuerunt se illi : sed Judith filia Merari in specie faciei suæ dissolvit eum.
text_pt: Testemunha disto é que já me fizeste enrugado, e a minha magreza já se levanta contra mim, e no meu rosto testifica contra mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐδήσατο τὰς τρίχας αὐτῆς ἐν μίτρᾳ καὶ ἔλαβεν στολὴν λινῆν εἰς ἀπάτην αὐτοῦ

text_en: For she put off her the garments of widowhood, and put on her the garments of joy , to give joy to the children of Israel .
text_la: Exuit enim se vestimento viduitatis, et induit se vestimento lætitiæ in exultatione filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Na sua ira me despedaçou, e ele me perseguiu; rangeu os seus dentes contra mim; aguça o meu adversário os seus olhos contra mim.
text_el: τὸ σανδάλιον αὐτῆς ἥρπασεν ὀφθαλμὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ κάλλος αὐτῆς ᾐχμαλώτισεν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ διῆλθεν ὁ ἀκινάκης τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ

text_en: She anointed her face with ointment , and bound up her locks with a crown, she took a new robe to deceive him.
text_la: Unxit faciem suam unguento, et colligavit cincinnos suos mitra; accepit stolam novem ad decipiendum illum.
text_pt: Abrem a sua boca contra mim; com desprezo me feriram nos queixos, e contra mim se ajuntam todos.
text_el: ἔφριξαν Πέρσαι τὴν τόλμαν αὐτῆς καὶ Μῆδοι τὸ θράσος αὐτῆς ἐταράχθησαν

text_en: Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty made his soul her captive, with a sword she cut off his head.
text_la: Sandalia ejus rapuerunt oculos ejus; pulchritudo ejus captivam fecit animam ejus : amputavit pugione cervicem ejus.
text_pt: Entrega-me Deus ao perverso, e nas mãos dos ímpios me faz cair.
text_el: τότε ἠλάλαξαν οἱ ταπεινοί μου καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν οἱ ἀσθενοῦντές μου καὶ ἐπτοήθησαν ὕψωσαν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνετράπησαν

text_en: The Persians quaked at her constancy, and the Medes at her boldness.
text_la: Horruerunt Persæ constantiam ejus, et Medi audaciam ejus.
text_pt: Descansado estava eu, porém ele me quebrantou; e pegou-me pela cerviz, e me despedaçou; também me pôs por seu alvo.
text_el: υἱοὶ κορασίων κατεκέντησαν αὐτοὺς καὶ ὡς παῖδας αὐτομολούντων ἐτίτρωσκον αὐτούς ἀπώλοντο ἐκ παρατάξεως κυρίου μου

text_en: Then the camp of the Assyrians howled, when my lowly ones appeared, parched with thirst.
text_la: Tunc ululaverunt castra Assyriorum, quando apparuerunt humiles mei, arescentes in siti.
text_pt: Cercam-me os seus flecheiros; atravessa-me os rins, e não me poupa, e o meu fel derrama sobre a terra,
text_el: ὑμνήσω τῷ θεῷ μου ὕμνον καινόν κύριε μέγας εἶ καὶ ἔνδοξος θαυμαστὸς ἐν ἰσχύι ἀνυπέρβλητος

text_en: The sons of the damsels have pierced them through, and they have killed them like children fleeing away: they perished in battle before the face of the Lord my God .
text_la: Filii puellarum compunxerunt eos, et sicut pueros fugientes occiderunt eos : perierunt in prælio a facie Domini Dei mei.
text_pt: Fere-me com ferimento sobre ferimento; arremete contra mim como um valente.
text_el: σοὶ δουλευσάτω πᾶσα ἡ κτίσις σου ὅτι εἶπας καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ἀπέστειλας τὸ πνεῦμά σου καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὃς ἀντιστήσεται τῇ φωνῇ σου

text_en: Let us sing a hymn to the Lord , let us sing a new hymn to our God .
text_la: Hymnum cantemus Domino; hymnum novum cantemus Deo nostro.
text_pt: Cosi sobre a minha pele o cilício, e revolvi a minha cabeça no pó.
text_el: ὄρη γὰρ ἐκ θεμελίων σὺν ὕδασιν σαλευθήσεται πέτραι δ' ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ὡς κηρὸς τακήσονται ἔτι δὲ τοῖς φοβουμένοις σε σὺ εὐιλατεύσεις αὐτοῖς

text_en: O Adonai , Lord , great are you, and glorious in your power, and no one can overcome you.
text_la: Adonai Domine, magnus es tu, et præclarus in virtute tua : et quem superare nemo potest.
text_pt: O meu rosto está todo avermelhado de chorar, e sobre as minhas pálpebras está a sombra da morte:
text_el: ὅτι μικρὸν πᾶσα θυσία εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καὶ ἐλάχιστον πᾶν στέαρ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμά σοι ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος τὸν κύριον μέγας διὰ παντός

text_en: Let all your creatures serve you: because you have spoken, and they were made: you sent forth your spirit, and they were created , and there is no one that can resist your voice.
text_la: Tibi serviat omnis creatura tua, quia dixisti, et facta sunt; misisti spiritum tuum, et creata sunt : et non est qui resistat voci tuæ.
text_pt: Apesar de não haver violência nas minhas mãos, e de ser pura a minha oração.
text_el: οὐαὶ ἔθνεσιν ἐπανιστανομένοις τῷ γένει μου κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἐκδικήσει αὐτοὺς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως δοῦναι πῦρ καὶ σκώληκας εἰς σάρκας αὐτῶν καὶ κλαύσονται ἐν αἰσθήσει ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: The mountains shall be moved from the foundations with the waters: the rocks shall melt as wax before your face.
text_la: Montes a fundamentis movebuntur cum aquis; petræ, sicut cera, liquescent ante faciem tuam.
text_pt: Ah! terra, não cubras o meu sangue e não haja lugar para ocultar o meu clamor!
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤλθοσαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ προσεκύνησαν τῷ θεῷ καὶ ἡνίκα ἐκαθαρίσθη ὁ λαός ἀνήνεγκαν τὰ ὁλοκαυτώματα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἑκούσια αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ δόματα

text_en: But they that fear you, shall be great with you in all things.
text_la: Qui autem timent te, magni erunt apud te per omnia.
text_pt: Eis que também agora a minha testemunha está no céu, e nas alturas o meu testemunho está.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέθηκεν Ιουδιθ πάντα τὰ σκεύη Ολοφέρνου ὅσα ἔδωκεν ὁ λαὸς αὐτῇ καὶ τὸ κωνώπιον ὃ ἔλαβεν ἑαυτῇ ἐκ τοῦ κοιτῶνος αὐτοῦ εἰς ἀνάθημα τῷ θεῷ ἔδωκεν

text_en: Woe be to the nation that rises up against my people: for the Lord almighty will take revenge on them, in the day of judgment he will visit them.
text_la: Væ genti insurgenti super genus meum : Dominus enim omnipotens vindicabit in eis; in die judicii visitabit illos.
text_pt: Os meus amigos são os que zombam de mim; os meus olhos se desfazem em lágrimas diante de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς εὐφραινόμενος ἐν Ιερουσαλημ κατὰ πρόσωπον τῶν ἁγίων ἐπὶ μῆνας τρεῖς καὶ Ιουδιθ μετ' αὐτῶν κατέμεινεν

text_en: For he will give fire, and worms into their flesh, that they may burn, and may feel for ever.
text_la: Dabit enim ignem et vermes in carnes eorum, ut urantur et sentiant usque in sempiternum.
text_pt: Ah! se alguém pudesse contender com Deus pelo homem, como o homem pelo seu próximo!
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας ἀνέζευξεν ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν κληρονομίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ Ιουδιθ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς Βαιτυλουα καὶ κατέμεινεν ἐπὶ τῆς ὑπάρξεως αὐτῆς καὶ ἐγένετο κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῆς ἔνδοξος ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: And it came to pass after these things, that all the people, after the victory, came to Jerusalem to adore the Lord : and as soon as they were purified, they all offered holocausts , and vows , and their promises.
text_la: Et factum est post hæc, omnis populus post victoriam venit in Jerusalem adorare Dominum : et mox ut purificati sunt, obtulerunt omnes holocausta, et vota, et repromissiones suas.
text_pt: Porque decorridos poucos anos, eu seguirei o caminho por onde não tornarei.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπεθύμησαν αὐτήν καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω ἀνὴρ αὐτὴν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς αὐτῆς ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας ἀπέθανεν Μανασσης ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Judith offered for an anathema of oblivion all the arms of Holofernes, which the people gave her, and the canopy that she had taken away out of his chamber.
text_la: Porro Judith universa vasa bellica Holofernis, quæ dedit illi populus, et conopeum quod ipsa sustulerat de cubili ipsius, obtulit in anathema oblivionis.
text_el: καὶ ἦν προβαίνουσα μεγάλη σφόδρα καὶ ἐγήρασεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς ἔτη ἑκατὸν πέντε καὶ ἀφῆκεν τὴν ἅβραν αὐτῆς ἐλευθέραν καὶ ἀπέθανεν εἰς Βαιτυλουα καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὴν ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς Μανασση

text_en: And the people were joyful in the sight of the sanctuary, and for three months the joy of this victory was celebrated with Judith.
text_la: Erat autem populus jucundus secundum faciem sanctorum : et per tres menses gaudium hujus victoriæ celebratum est cum Judith.
text_el: καὶ ἐπένθησεν αὐτὴν οἶκος Ισραηλ ἡμέρας ἑπτά καὶ διεῖλεν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῆς πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτὴν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔγγιστα Μανασση τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ τοῖς ἔγγιστα τοῦ γένους αὐτῆς

text_en: And after those days every man returned to his house, and Judith was made great in Bethulia , and she was most renowned in all the land of Israel .
text_la: Post dies autem illos, unusquisque rediit in domum suam : et Judith magna facta est in Bethulia, et præclarior erat universæ terræ Israël.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἔτι ὁ ἐκφοβῶν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ιουδιθ καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτὴν ἡμέρας πολλάς

text_en: And chastity was joined to her virtue , so that she knew no man all the days of her life, after the death of Manasses her husband.
text_la: Erat enim virtuti castitas adjuncta, ita ut non cognosceret virum omnibus diebus vitæ suæ, ex quo defunctus est Manasses vir ejus.

text_en: And on festival days she came forth with great glory .
text_la: Erat autem, diebus festis, procedens cum magna gloria.

text_en: And she abode in her husband's house a hundred and five years, and made her handmaid free, and she died, and was buried with her husband in Bethulia .
text_la: Mansit autem in domo viri sui annos centum quinque, et dimisit abram suam liberam : et defuncta est ac sepulta cum viro suo in Bethulia.

text_en: And all the people mourned for seven days.
text_la: Luxitque illam omnis populus diebus septem.

text_en: And all the time of her life there was none that troubled Israel , nor many years after her death.
text_la: In omni autem spatio vitæ ejus non fuit qui perturbaret Israël, et post mortem ejus annis multis.

text_en: But the day of the festivity of this victory is received by the Hebrews in the number of holy days, and is religiously observed by the Jews from that time until this day.
text_la: Dies autem victoriæ hujus festivitatis ab Hebræis in numero sanctorum dierum accipitur, et colitur a Judæis ex illo tempore usque in præsentem diem.
